ZAF.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
No government body is stated to use AI.
No AI tool in a public sector system stated.

facts.fact: The University of Cape Town reports that its team developed MzansiText, a multilingual dataset of South Africa's 11 official written languages, and MzansiLM, a 125-million-parameter language model trained on it from scratch, and made both publicly available.

ZAF.note: Document states nothing on internet in schools or the secondary curriculum.
